title: decision_log_entry is P7's, the record is local and the ledger is central, and no source says whether the migrated legacy entries are published as records or handed over as a file, nor who continues the hash chain
source: Ownership Map v1 decision_log_entry (owner P7); Template and Rules R5.5 DP-03; the shared topic rwb.decision-record.v1 (Template and Rules R4); legacy RWB-DM-012 AC1 and Data table
section: 1 Story; 11 Data; 12.3 Events published; 12.7 Tables owned; 19 Out of scope
description: Legacy RWB-DM-012 migrates decision_log_entry into the monolith's single decision log, keyed to recovery_case. In the target one PostgreSQL schema and one login exist per service, no service writes another service's schema, the table belongs to P7 rwb-decision, and a decision record is written locally by the owning service in the same transaction as its state change and sealed centrally through rwb.decision-record.v1. The Work Package gives AC1 and AC3 to RWB-P1-DM012-APP, adds DP-03 with H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, and gives AC2 to RWB-ITG-DM012-ITG. No source states whether the historical entries taken outside the Workbench are published as DecisionRecorded events in chain order or handed over as a file for rwb-decision to load, and no source states which party continues the hash chain after cutover or where the sealing acknowledgement is read.
evidence: Ownership Map v1 tables.decision_log_entry.owner = P7 (basis Architecture v5 slide 41, TSD P7 v2 T3.1); Template and Rules R5.5 DP-03 (local decision-record library and topic rwb.decision-record.v1, H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON); Template and Rules R4 (shared topic rwb.decision-record.v1); legacy RWB-DM-012 Data table decision_log_entry DF-DEC-001 to DF-DEC-031 and AC1 'no entry is rewritten, renumbered or re-hashed'; legacy Endpoints: No endpoint in this story.
proposed: P1 extracts the entries in chain order and emits each one through the local decision-record library as DecisionRecorded on rwb.decision-record.v1 with its original chain_seq, prev_hash and entry_hash; rwb-decision seals them into the central ledger and P1 writes no decision_log_entry row and holds no grant on rwb_decision.

title: The legacy decision-log extract's source, format and location, the retention period of the legacy tables and the place that holds the sign-off are not specified
source: WP B2-P1-011; legacy RWB-DM-012 story, Endpoints, Screen and states, AC1 and AC3; FSD P1 v3 A2.17; TSD P1 v3 T3.2
section: 3 Preconditions; 5 Exception paths; 9 State transitions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 19 Out of scope
description: AC1 and AC3 name a cutover read of the legacy decisions and a ten-clean-day sign-off, but no source states where the legacy Workbench decision log is exported to, in which format, who produces the extract, how long the legacy tables stay read-only after the sign-off, or where the data steward's sign-off is recorded. The legacy story gives no endpoint ('No endpoint in this story') and no screen ('No screen in this story'), and the FSD gives a retention class per Workbench record class but no value for a legacy table. The story therefore reads the extract once from a cutover dump held by the release pipeline and records the sign-off in the cutover record, and writes 'Not specified in the source documents (CG-B2-P1-011-2; ASM-B2-P1-011-1)' wherever the extract's source, format, location or the retention period would go.
evidence: Legacy RWB-DM-012 Endpoints: 'No endpoint in this story. The migration is a cutover step run by the recovery service identity, and its breaks are listed on the reconciliation extract.'; Screen and states: 'No screen in this story.'; AC3: 'the legacy tables stay read-only for their retention period'; FSD P1 v3 A2.17 gives a retention class per record class and no period; TSD P1 v3 T3.2 gives the Flyway sequence but no cutover artefact.
owner_role: Data steward and data product owner
proposed: Take the extract from the legacy Workbench cutover dump of the release pipeline, name its format and location in the cutover plan, take the retention period from the retention class of the record class in retention_rule, and hold the sign-off in the cutover record.
